question: Identify the best method to prepare washing soda from sodium bicarbonate.

options.text: By adding sodium bicarbonate to vinegar
By mixing sodium bicarbonate with water

solution:
The correct answer is __**By heating sodium bicarbonate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Heating sodium bicarbonate leads to its decomposition into sodium carbonate (washing soda), carbon dioxide, and water.
 
• This is a straightforward and effective method to obtain washing soda from sodium bicarbonate.
 
• It is a thermal decomposition reaction, represented by the equation: **2NaHCO₃ → Na₂CO₃ + CO₂ + H₂O**.
 
• This method is commonly used in laboratories and industrial settings to produce washing soda.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃)**, also known as baking soda, is a versatile compound used in baking, cleaning, and fire extinguishing.
 
• **Washing soda (Na₂CO₃)** is an important compound in the manufacture of glass, soap, and detergent, and is widely used as a cleaning agent.
 
• The process of heating sodium bicarbonate to produce washing soda is known as **dehydration**, where water molecules are removed from the substance.
 
• Carbon dioxide (CO₂) released during the reaction is a gas that is also used in the production of carbonated drinks.
 
• This method is highly efficient and produces high-purity washing soda when performed at the right temperature (about 200°C to 250°C).
 
• Alternatives such as adding sodium bicarbonate to vinegar or mixing it with water do not lead to the production of washing soda but may result in other reactions, such as the formation of carbonic acid or a simple solution.
